title: Supported languages and currencies
section: Language list, country/currency table and France footnote
rule_summary: Any supported Merchant language may be used in supported target countries. Country table is separate from approval; France coverage excludes overseas territories.

title: How to fix: Country where you sell products not supported
rule_summary: SV is explicitly a beta target. The account country selector is the next place to verify target support.

title: About beta countries for Shopping ads and free listings
rule_summary: Beta participation may be restricted to some retailers and serving surfaces can differ.

title: Syncing your products (Google and YouTube app on Shopify)
section: Country/language table; overlapping markets; data source changes
rule_summary: App sync scope differs from general Shopping tables. Overlap may produce separate country data sources/labels; data rules and campaign filters need readback.

title: About currency conversion
rule_summary: Conversion is automatic in Merchant accounts, except South Korea. Submitted currency remains on the site; target-country shipping and applicable price/tax requirements still apply.

title: About language targeting
publication_or_effective_date: Announces start in September 2026; no exact account rollout date
rule_summary: Search campaign language setting is being removed; ad-language matching replaces it. PMax Search changes similarly; other PMax channel controls remain; Shopping is unaffected.

title: Shopping ads policies
rule_summary: Ads to people located in Russia are paused. Advertisers based in Russia also face the stated global pause; no claim is made about this store being based there.

title: About Reach Planner
rule_summary: Current help separately confirms Google Ads serving to users in Russia is paused. This is not a list of Search campaign country eligibility.

title: Show products in multiple target countries
rule_summary: Merchant target countries, product/shipping setup and Ads location selection must align. Multi-country shipping services alone do not add target countries.

title: About landing page requirements
rule_summary: Submitted offer, variant, price, currency and language must match the landing experience; important checkout content must match the feed language.

title: Update to Shopping ads and free listing policies
rule_summary: Consolidates policy documentation without introducing substantive restrictions or stricter enforcement; no country expansion or clearance is promised.

title: Pickup cost and minimum order values for in-store products
rule_summary: New pickup reporting condition is limited to in-store pickup products with relevant charges/minima in UK, Switzerland and EEA; no invented store pickup required.

title: Minimum order value attribute
rule_summary: If an order minimum exists, account/product configuration must express it accurately; item shipping can override account minimum settings. It is distinct from a free-shipping threshold.

title: Merchant Center product data specification update 2026
rule_summary: The retrieved annual article places 500x500 image enforcement on January 31, 2027, not September 2026; no image change is part of this task.

title: Understanding Google Ads country restrictions
publication_or_effective_date: Undated current help; accessed through official search result
rule_summary: Google Ads has its own geographic restrictions. Absence from a Merchant country table does not establish a Search prohibition.
